entries.rationale: Explicit typeof disjunction narrows number/boolean/bigint/symbol/undefined before String. String remains early-return; all other objects/functions return null so unknownErrorMessage retains safe fallback. Error/null outer cases unchanged; arbitrary object coercion still impossible through this helper. Removed now-unused Set only.

Private authorization parameter now derives exact IncomingHttpHeaders authorization string|undefined type. Sole call receives native request.headers.authorization. Regex receives same string-or-empty value without redundant String; expectedToken await, constant-time equality,401 challenge/200 payload and outer500catch unchanged.

edgeEvidence: Function and throwing Symbol.toPrimitive object receive safe fallback without coercion. Existing synthetic-secret object remains unrevealed.
Real HTTP fixture checks missing/empty/malformed/wrong bearer401 plus challenge and existing valid bearer200.
limits: This is implementing-agent verification, not a second independent reviewer approval.
No commit/push, workflow change or Snyk review mutation.
No live providers used; status server remains loopback fixture.
No exact behavior claim for direct non-string invocation of private helper outside its native Node caller contract.
